title: TikTok for Business MCP Server
content_data:
Launch hundreds of campaigns in minutes. Scale top performers with a single request. Keep your creatives and catalogs autonomously optimized around the clock. TikTok for Business MCP Server turns these workflows into native capabilities for your AI agents, giving your team a first-class foundation to build on TikTok Ads.


The server is a standardized bridge, built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), that connects your AI agents directly to the TikTok Ads platform. It packages approximately 400 TikTok API for Business endpoints as structured, discoverable MCP tools — a ready-made toolbox your agents can use to manage campaigns, analyze performance, configure audiences, operate catalogs, and handle creative assets through natural-language instructions.


For teams building AI-powered advertising, this changes the starting line. Skip the technical heavy lifting and focus entirely on the product experience. Because the server already speaks the protocol your agents understand, complex ad operations are executed in plain language instead of endless clicks. Connect once, and unlock the full breadth of TikTok advertising.



## What you can do
With TikTok for Business MCP Server, your agents can mix and match hundreds of advertising actions across the entire campaign lifecycle:
- **End-to-end campaign management**: Create, update, and manage Upgraded Smart+ campaigns, ad groups, ads, and GMV Max Campaigns with full lifecycle control.
- **Comprehensive reporting and insights**: Access detailed performance data across campaigns, ad groups, ads, and creatives to inform AI-driven optimization decisions.
- **Catalog management**: Create catalogs, upload and update product data at scale, and access diagnostic information to keep catalogs healthy and ad-ready.
- **Creative management**: Search, upload, and manage creative assets such as images and music, and configure portfolios for streamlined creative operations.
- **Audience management**: Manage Custom Audiences and Lookalike Audiences to ensure you always target the most relevant and up-to-date segments.
- **Business Center operations**: Manage TikTok ad accounts, users, assets, and financial settings to reduce operational overhead while maintaining control.


## Use cases

**1. Compose an entire workflow from one instruction.**

Imagine a product you ship to a fashion retailer that needs to clear seasonal inventory. Through your agent, the retailer states a single goal:

"Create a holiday sale campaign for all in-stock products with high inventory, use the best-performing creatives, set the budget to $10,000, and prepare it for launch tomorrow."

Your agent chains MCP tools into a complete workflow:

1. Builds a product set from the catalog.

2. Retrieves the top-performing creatives from past campaigns.

3. Assembles the campaign, ad group, and ad.

4. Configures budget, targeting, and scheduling.

5. Submits the campaign for review.


**Result:** A complete campaign, assembled in minutes and a workflow you can reuse across every client.



**2. Build a growth loop that learns.**

The same retailer wants to keep scaling what performs. Through your agent, the request is simple:

"Find what's working in my spring collection and scale it."Your agent:

1. Queries reporting endpoints to identify the best-performing products, audiences, and creatives.

2. Builds new product sets around the winning products.

3. Uploads fresh creative variants aligned with the top-performing themes.

4. Shifts budget toward the combinations with the highest return on ad spend (ROAS).


**Result:** A reusable growth loop that turns performance insight into scaling action, one conversation at a time.



## Key benefits
- **Unlock end-to-end AI-powered automation:** Move beyond manual campaign management through a dashboard interface. With TikTok for Business MCP Server, AI agents can execute complete advertising workflows — from campaign creation and audience targeting to real-time bidding adjustments and performance reporting — without human intervention at every step.
- **Drive continuously improving performance:** With TikTok advertising capabilities exposed as standardized MCP tools, AI agents can run campaigns, analyze results, identify optimization opportunities, and implement changes in rapid cycles. This continuous feedback loop can drive progressively stronger outcomes over time, a level of responsiveness that manual management is unlikely to achieve.
- **Get started in minutes with zero-code setup:** No developer credential, API key management, or custom coding is required. TikTok for Business MCP Server is designed for immediate connectivity, so you can start connecting your AI tools to TikTok Ads right away using the agents and platforms you already work with.
- **Future-proof your advertising technology stack:** By adopting the MCP standard today, you lay the groundwork for building, distributing, and scaling AI-powered advertising solutions as the ecosystem grows. As new tools and capabilities are added to the server, your connected agents gain access automatically, ensuring your infrastructure evolves alongside the platform.


## Who is this for
- **Developers** building AI-powered advertising tools, platforms, or internal automation systems that need programmatic access to TikTok Ads functionality through a standardized protocol.
- **Advertisers and agencies** who want to leverage AI agents to manage and optimize their TikTok advertising campaigns more efficiently, without writing custom API integration code. Bring your preferred agent, connect it, and let it work.


## Key concepts
Understanding the following concepts helps you make architectural decisions when integrating TikTok for Business MCP Server.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: An open protocol that standardizes how AI agents discover, connect to, and interact with external platforms and services. Think of MCP as a universal adapter: any compatible agent can automatically discover and use TikTok Ads tools without custom integration work. The protocol handles authentication, capability discovery, and structured communication between agents and the server.
- **AI agent**: An LLM-powered system that connects to external tools, uses artificial intelligence to reason about goals and context, and executes decisions autonomously. In the advertising context, an agent connected to TikTok for Business MCP Server can create campaigns, pull performance reports, adjust budgets, refine audiences, and optimize creative — all based on high-level business objectives rather than step-by-step instructions.
- **MCP tools**: Individual functions exposed by the MCP Server that represent discrete advertising operations, such as "create campaign," "get performance report," "update audience targeting," or "pause ad group." Agents call these tools as needed to perform actions on TikTok Ads, combining them in sequences to accomplish complex workflows.
- **Tool loading strategies**: To balance context efficiency against immediate tool access, the server offers two loading modes:
```xtable
|Strategy {20%}|Behavior {40%}|When to use {40%}|
|---|---|---|
|Full Disclosure|The server provides the complete list of all available tools and their full schemas to the AI agent at initialization.|Large context windows. Workflows that need immediate access to any tool without a discovery step|
|Progressive Disclosure|The server initially exposes a smaller number of available tools. When the agent needs a specific capability, it queries the server to dynamically load only the relevant tool schemas on-demand.|Token-constrained environments. Sessions that typically use a small subset of the full tool library.|
```


## Supported scope and limitations
TikTok for Business MCP Server provides access to a wide range of existing TikTok API for Business endpoints, each packaged as an MCP tool. The server currently supports approximately 400 tools spanning campaign management, reporting, catalog operations, creative management, audience configuration, Business Center administration, and more.


**Limitations:**
- Not all TikTok API for Business endpoints are available yet. For the complete list of supported tools, see [Available tools in TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/available-tools-in-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3).
- Rate limit: 6 queries per second (QPS) per tool per TikTok for Business user. For example, you can call `smart_plus_ad_create` and `smart_plus_ad_update` each three times per second, creating three Upgraded Smart+ Ads and updating three others within the same one-second window.
- Authorization lifespan: User authorization for the TikTok for Business MCP Server connection remains valid for a 30-day window. After 30 days, you will need to reauthorize the connection using the same TikTok for Business account.
- Tool availability may vary by region and account configuration.


## Next steps
To learn about the MCP server URLs and the steps for connecting to TikTok for Business MCP Server, see [How to connect a ready-made agent to TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3) and [How to connect a custom agent to TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3).
